title: IBM Cloud Resource Schema
description: Core data models for IBM Cloud resources, identities, and access management objects. These schemas define the structure of resources managed through IBM Cloud IAM and resource management APIs.

CRN.title: Cloud Resource Name
CRN.description: A Cloud Resource Name (CRN) is a globally unique identifier for IBM Cloud resources, following the format crn:version:cname:ctype:service-name:location:scope:service-instance:resource-type:resource.

AccountId.title: IBM Cloud Account ID
AccountId.description: A unique identifier for an IBM Cloud account.

IamId.title: IAM Identity ID
IamId.description: A unique identifier for an IAM identity such as a user, service ID, or trusted profile.

Timestamp.title: ISO 8601 Timestamp
Timestamp.description: A date and time value in ISO 8601 format.

ResourceInstance.title: Resource Instance
ResourceInstance.description: An IBM Cloud resource instance represents a provisioned service or infrastructure resource within an account.

id.description: The unique identifier of the resource instance.

guid.description: The globally unique identifier of the resource instance.

url.description: The relative URL of the resource instance.

crn.description: The Cloud Resource Name for this resource instance.

name.description: The human-readable name of the resource instance.

account_id.description: The account that owns this resource instance.

resource_group_id.description: The ID of the resource group containing this instance.

resource_group_crn.description: The CRN of the resource group.

resource_id.description: The unique ID of the offering.

resource_plan_id.description: The unique ID of the plan associated with the offering.

target_crn.description: The full deployment CRN for the resource.

parameters.description: Configuration parameters for the resource instance.

allow_cleanup.description: Whether the resource instance is subject to automatic cleanup.

state.description: The current state of the resource instance.

type.description: The type of the resource instance.

region_id.description: The region or location where the resource is deployed.

dashboard_url.description: The URL of the resource instance dashboard.

last_operation.description: The status of the last operation on this resource.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the resource was created.

created_by.description: The IAM ID of the user who created the resource.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the resource was last updated.

updated_by.description: The IAM ID of the user who last updated the resource.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the resource was deleted.

deleted_by.description: The IAM ID of the user who deleted the resource.

locked.description: Whether the resource instance is locked against modification.

tags.description: User-defined tags attached to the resource.

access_tags.description: Access management tags attached to the resource.

LastOperation.title: Last Operation
LastOperation.description: The status of the most recent asynchronous operation performed on a resource instance.

type.description: The type of the last operation.

state.description: The state of the last operation.

sub_type.description: The sub-type of the last operation.

description.description: A description of the last operation result.

reason_code.description: The reason code if the operation failed.

poll_after.description: Seconds to wait before polling for operation status.

cancelable.description: Whether the operation can be cancelled.

poll.description: Whether the status should be polled.

ResourceGroup.title: Resource Group
ResourceGroup.description: A resource group is a logical container for organizing and managing IBM Cloud resources within an account.

id.description: The unique identifier of the resource group.

crn.description: The Cloud Resource Name for this resource group.

account_id.description: The account that owns this resource group.

name.description: The name of the resource group.

state.description: The current state of the resource group.

default.description: Whether this is the default resource group for the account.

quota_id.description: The quota ID associated with the resource group.

quota_url.description: The URL to retrieve the quota details.

payment_methods_url.description: The URL to retrieve payment methods.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the resource group was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the resource group was last updated.

ServiceId.title: Service ID
ServiceId.description: A service ID represents an identity for an application or service that authenticates with IBM Cloud using API keys.

id.description: The unique identifier of the service ID.

entity_tag.description: The entity tag for optimistic concurrency control.

crn.description: The Cloud Resource Name for this service ID.

locked.description: Whether the service ID is locked against modification.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the service ID was created.

modified_at.description: Timestamp when the service ID was last modified.

account_id.description: The account that owns this service ID.

name.description: The name of the service ID.

description.description: A description of the service ID.

unique_instance_crns.description: CRNs that restrict the scope of the service ID to specific resource instances.

ApiKey.title: API Key
ApiKey.description: An IAM API key used to authenticate a user or service ID with IBM Cloud services.

id.description: The unique identifier of the API key.

entity_tag.description: The entity tag for optimistic concurrency control.

crn.description: The Cloud Resource Name for this API key.

locked.description: Whether the API key is locked against modification.

disabled.description: Whether the API key is disabled for authentication.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the API key was created.

created_by.description: The IAM ID of the user who created the API key.

modified_at.description: Timestamp when the API key was last modified.

name.description: The name of the API key.

description.description: A description of the API key.

iam_id.description: The IAM ID associated with this API key.

account_id.description: The account this API key belongs to.

support_sessions.description: Whether sessions are supported for this API key.

action_when_leaked.description: Action to perform when the API key is leaked.

expires_at.description: Expiration date and time for the API key.

TrustedProfile.title: Trusted Profile
TrustedProfile.description: A trusted profile allows federated users and compute resources to assume an identity with specific access rights on IBM Cloud.

id.description: The unique identifier of the trusted profile.

entity_tag.description: The entity tag for optimistic concurrency control.

crn.description: The Cloud Resource Name for this trusted profile.

name.description: The name of the trusted profile.

description.description: A description of the trusted profile.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the profile was created.

modified_at.description: Timestamp when the profile was last modified.

iam_id.description: The IAM ID of the trusted profile.

account_id.description: The account that owns this trusted profile.

template_id.description: The ID of the template this profile was created from.

AccessPolicy.title: Access Policy
AccessPolicy.description: An IAM access policy that grants a subject a set of roles on a resource or set of resources in IBM Cloud.

id.description: The unique identifier of the policy.

subjects.description: The subjects the policy applies to.

roles.description: The roles granted by the policy.

resources.description: The resources the policy applies to.

state.description: The current state of the policy.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the policy was created.

created_by_id.description: The IAM ID of the user who created the policy.

last_modified_at.description: Timestamp when the policy was last modified.

last_modified_by_id.description: The IAM ID of the user who last modified the policy.

PolicySubject.title: Policy Subject
PolicySubject.description: A subject in a policy that identifies who the policy applies to, such as a user, service ID, or access group.

attributes.description: The attributes that identify the subject.

PolicyRole.title: Policy Role
PolicyRole.description: A role assigned in a policy, identified by its CRN.

display_name.description: The display name of the role.

PolicyResource.title: Policy Resource
PolicyResource.description: A resource in a policy that identifies what the policy grants access to.

attributes.description: The attributes that identify the resource.

PolicyAttribute.title: Policy Attribute
PolicyAttribute.description: An attribute used to identify a subject or resource in a policy, consisting of a name-value pair with an optional comparison operator.

name.description: The attribute name, such as accountId, serviceName, or iam_id.

Role.title: IAM Role
Role.description: An IAM role that defines a set of actions a subject can perform on a resource. Roles can be system-defined, service-defined, or custom.

id.description: The unique identifier of the role.

display_name.description: The display name of the role.

actions.description: The list of actions granted by this role.

name.description: The programmatic name identifier of the role.

account_id.description: The account ID for custom roles.

service_name.description: The service this role applies to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the role was created.

last_modified_at.description: Timestamp when the role was last modified.

AccessGroup.title: Access Group
AccessGroup.description: An access group organizes users and service IDs into a group for simplified access management in IBM Cloud.

id.description: The unique identifier of the access group.

name.description: The name of the access group.

description.description: A description of the access group.

account_id.description: The account that owns this access group.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the access group was created.

created_by_id.description: The IAM ID of the user who created the access group.

last_modified_at.description: Timestamp when the access group was last modified.

last_modified_by_id.description: The IAM ID of the user who last modified the access group.

href.description: The URL of the access group.

is_federated.description: Whether the access group is federated.

membership_type.description: The type of membership for the group.

Tag.title: Resource Tag
Tag.description: A tag attached to an IBM Cloud resource for organization, access control, or cost tracking.

name.description: The tag name. User tags follow the format key:value. Access tags follow the format key:value with restricted characters.

Account.title: IBM Cloud Account
Account.description: An IBM Cloud account that serves as the billing and access management boundary for cloud resources.

id.description: The unique identifier of the account.

state.description: The current state of the account.

owner_iam_id.description: The IAM ID of the account owner.

enterprise_id.description: The enterprise ID if this account belongs to an enterprise.

enterprise_account_id.description: The enterprise account ID if applicable.

enterprise_path.description: The path in the enterprise hierarchy.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the account was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the account was last updated.

PaginatedResponse.title: Paginated Response
PaginatedResponse.description: Standard pagination wrapper used across IBM Cloud APIs for list operations.

offset.description: The offset of the current page.

limit.description: The number of results per page.

first.description: URL to the first page of results.

previous.description: URL to the previous page of results.

next.description: URL to the next page of results.

last.description: URL to the last page of results.

ErrorResponse.title: Error Response
ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response returned by IBM Cloud APIs when a request fails.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: An individual error within an error response.

more_info.description: A URL to documentation about the error.

type.description: The type of the error target.

name.description: The name of the problematic field, parameter, or header.
